dishes.name: Utrecht botersprits
dishes.desc: Salty butter spritz biscuit made to Pieter Bergman's 1888 recipe, still baked and sold by a bakery near the Dom Tower.

dishes.name: Domtorentjes
dishes.desc: Chocolate bonbons with a creamy filling and a Dom Tower relief on top, an Utrecht sweet since 1922, sold in a bakery by the Dom.

dishes.name: Vockingworst
dishes.desc: Liver sausage from Utrecht, served as a bar snack. A local butcher's speciality.

dishes.name: Erwtensoep
dishes.desc: Thick split-pea soup with smoked sausage and pork, so thick a spoon stands up in it. A winter staple.
